desc: Designed for subcompact and compact handguns, the TLR-3X delivers 500 lumens of brightness and a 161-meter beam for clear visibility. Constructed from durable polymer and tested in extreme temperatures, it performs reliably in challenging conditions. Its slim profile, reversible rail clamps, and multiple paddle switches provide a customizable fit across a wide range of firearms. The innovative mounting system enables quick, secure installation and removal-without placing your hands in front of the muzzle.
